india_context.procedural_notes: Algorithmic decision systems impacting personal liberty, state welfare benefits, or employment rights are subject to judicial review under Articles 14, 19, and 21 of the Constitution.
india_context.transitional_notes: NITI Aayog 'Responsible AI for All' guidelines provide national ethical benchmarking.
